TacticalMessage.title: TacticalMessage
TacticalMessage.description: Real-time message in a Desert Force communication channel, scoped to authenticated user workspace.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user owning this channel message stream.

channelId.description: Identifier of the communication channel (e.g., global-command, humanitarian-relief, desert-ops-intel, education-briefings, arabic-dispatch).

senderName.description: Display name or callsign of the sender.

senderRole.description: Tactical or humanitarian role of the sender.

content.description: Primary text body of the message.

languageCode.description: ISO language code of the message content (e.g., en, ar, fr, es, zh, ru, tr, hi).

isAiGenerated.description: Whether the message was drafted or generated by the Desert Force AI Command Assistant.

translatedContent.description: Optional translated message text produced by the real-time AI translator.

translatedLang.description: Optional target language code of the translation.

attachmentTitle.description: Optional multimedia or educational document attachment title.

attachmentType.description: Optional attachment type (IMAGE, PDF, AUDIO, BRIEF).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

IntelDocument.title: IntelDocument
IntelDocument.description: Educational document, field manual, or multimedia briefing shared within The Desert Force.

summary.description: Detailed abstract or educational content of the document.

readTimeMinutes.description: Estimated reading or review duration in minutes.

bookmarked.description: Whether the user has bookmarked this document for offline tactical reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AdvocacyCampaign.title: AdvocacyCampaign
AdvocacyCampaign.description: Digital advocacy and global humanitarian awareness campaign.

title.description: Title of the humanitarian cause or awareness campaign.

region.description: Geographic region or global corridor impacted.

impactSummary.description: Verified field impact summary and awareness briefing.

supportersCount.description: Number of verified digital advocates amplifying this campaign.

pledgedSupport.description: Whether the current user has pledged solidarity and amplified the campaign.

urgencyLevel.description: Urgency level of the humanitarian situation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time tactical and humanitarian channel messages isolated per authenticated user workspace.

/intel_docs/{docId}.description: Educational documents, field briefings, and multimedia resources.

/advocacy_campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Digital advocacy and global humanitarian awareness campaigns.
